headline: Gold edges up ₹124 today; silver flat at ₹1,75,000 per kg
summary: Gold 24K rose ₹124 per gram today (about 0.98%) to ₹12,780, and 22K rose ₹115 to ₹11,715, a small daily move. Over the last 7 days gold fell about 6%, and across the 30 days of history it is down about 10.5%, with the 24K high of ₹14,602 on 5 November and the low of ₹12,508 on 21 November. Silver showed no change today at ₹1,75,000 per kg, but it is down about 7.9% over 7 days and about 20.5% since 26 October, when it stood at ₹2,20,000. Possible drivers include the US dollar and rupee exchange rate, international gold and silver prices, and import duty.
outlook: Prices have fallen sharply over the past week, so buyers may want to compare rates across jewellers and add GST and making charges to the quoted rate before deciding, since this is not financial advice.
